description: PRD-59: Workflow Engine V2 — Neural Swarm Bridge. 5 phases: (1) Stabilize current 9-stage pipeline by fixing 6 critical issues (Stage 7 scoring metadata not outputs, learning loop not closing, context optimization disabled, requires_context ignored, dual orchestrator implementations, graph metadata not propagating), (2) Replace fixed 9-stage sequence with dynamic PhaseSelector (5 phases: PLAN/PREPARE/EXECUTE/EVALUATE/LEARN), (3) TaskRunner bridge abstraction for distributed execution (Local→Queued→K8s), (4) Neural Field prototype for field-based agent coordination, (5) K8s microagent swarms with KEDA autoscaling.

userStories.title: Fix Stage 7: Evaluate real agent outputs instead of metadata
userStories.description: As the system, Stage 7 (Quality Assessment) must evaluate actual LLM agent outputs, not a metadata summary string. Currently OutputQualityAssessor is initialized with use_llm=False and scores a summary string containing subtask count/token count/status, producing meaningless scores that hover around 0.65-0.75 regardless of output quality.
acceptanceCriteria: In api/workflows.py Stage 7 section, initialize OutputQualityAssessor with use_llm=True and a real llm_client from create_llm_manager(service_name='orchestrator')
Build quality_summary from actual agent outputs: iterate execution_results, extract each step's description, agent_name, result (truncated to 2000 chars), and tokens_used
Format as JSON with task name, subtask_outputs array, and overall_success_rate
Quality scores should now produce meaningful variance: good outputs score 0.8-0.95, bad outputs score 0.3-0.5
Add feature flag ENABLE_LLM_QUALITY_ASSESSMENT=true (default: true) to control LLM-based vs heuristic assessment
For Atom/Molecule complexity tasks, fall back to heuristic assessment to save cost
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Close the learning loop: Stage 6 metrics flow into Stage 2 agent selection
userStories.description: As the system, the learning loop must fully close so agent selection improves over time. Stage 6's LearningSystemUpdater writes performance_metrics to the Agent DB, but LLMAgentSelector may not include these metrics in its selection prompt, meaning the system never gets smarter.
acceptanceCriteria: In core/llm/llm_agent_selector.py, verify the agent selection prompt includes for each candidate: success_rate, total_tasks_executed, and avg quality_score from agent.performance_metrics
If metrics are missing from the prompt, add them in the format: 'Agent: {name}, Skills: {skills}, Success Rate: {success_rate}, Tasks Completed: {total_tasks}, Avg Quality: {quality_score}'
The LLM receives all 4 signals from the scoring formula: 0.4 × skill_match + 0.3 × performance_history + 0.2 × (1 - load) + 0.1 × recency
Verify in modules/learning/engine/core.py that metrics are persisted correctly with exponential moving average (learning rate 0.1)
After 10+ executions, agents with higher success rates should be selected more frequently for matching task types

userStories.title: Re-enable context optimization pipeline (Shannon Entropy + MMR + Knapsack)
userStories.description: As the system, the mathematical context optimization pipeline in Stage 3 must be re-enabled. Currently disabled with log message 'Mathematical optimization DISABLED - using basic RAG only'. The pipeline should filter by Shannon Entropy (>4.0), diversify via MMR (lambda=0.7), and optimize token budget via Knapsack.
acceptanceCriteria: In modules/orchestrator/stages/context_engineering.py, investigate why optimization was disabled and fix the root cause
Re-enable Shannon Entropy filter: H(X) = -Sum p(xi) * log2(p(xi)), threshold > 4.0 bits, removes low-information boilerplate
Re-enable MMR diversity selection: MMR = arg max [lambda * Sim(di, q) - (1-lambda) * max Sim(di, dj)], lambda=0.7
Re-enable Knapsack token budget optimization: maximize Sum value(ci) * selected(ci) subject to Sum tokens(ci) * selected(ci) <= budget
Add feature flag ENABLE_CONTEXT_OPTIMIZATION=true (default: false initially for safe rollout)
Add unit tests for entropy filter, MMR selection, and knapsack optimizer independently
Log context optimization metrics: items_before, items_after_entropy, items_after_mmr, tokens_before, tokens_after_knapsack
Typecheck passes
